ambience.title: Reference beds — match each recording to the room it was made in
ambience.instruction: Play each reference, then assign every transmission to a room. Coll's chamber has ventilation, room resonance and — only while the telescope is tracking — a thin drive whine.
ambience.hint: Three transmissions have a thin high whine under the ventilation. Three do not. One of the three that does not is not the chamber at all.

phrasematch.title: Rehearsal, 21:40 — against this morning
phrasematch.instruction: Four of this morning's five short transmissions already existed last night. Pair them. One will not pair with anything.
phrasematch.hint: Listen to the words, not the tone. Four are verbatim. The fifth is a sentence Coll never had a reason to rehearse.

cardiac.title: Cardiac telemetry — identify the repeated interval
cardiac.instruction: Atrial fibrillation is irregular by definition — the interval between beats is effectively random. Play both windows. Select every four-minute interval whose beat pattern is identical to another interval.
cardiac.hint: Three of the four windows carry the same beat pattern. Only one of the three can be a living heart — the earliest. Everything after it is that same four minutes, played again.
cardiac.solution: Windows 2, 3 and 4 are the same recording. The chair buffered 11:38:20–11:42:20 and replayed it on a loop from 11:42:20 onward. The last real heartbeat is at the end of window 2.

packet.title: Calibration packet — 11:29:55, Spectra origin
packet.instruction: Select the field that does not belong in the calibration standard.
packet.hint: A calibration packet tells an instrument what it is. It has no business telling it when.
